analyst.text:
The market light is back to GREEN (VIX 17.2), and Nasdaq futures are +0.6%. Only 3 trading days remain before the Fri Oct 23 sell-by.
Plan: SELL ALL three holdings today and hold cash. CRWD is below its 8% stop. SNOW and AMD were rotated out at Monday's review. A green open is a good time to exit.
The engine lists V (#1) as a buy. I recommend skipping it: a 3-day hold has no reliable edge (our research showed 10-day outcomes are close to a coin flip), and the money is needed by Oct 30.
Selling at current prices leaves about $2,434, about -2.6% since Sep 28. Over the same period the system's simulated account is -8.8% and the S&P 500 is -0.3%.
After the deadline: restart only with money that has no near-term need. Either rebuild the strategy around next-day execution, or use an S&P 500 ETF.
